raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (and possibly other rows) stores txn_ts as 13-digit epoch-millisecond strings, such as '1768543592000', which is 2026-01-16 06:06:32 UTC, rather than 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' text, so the unconditional CAST to TIMESTAMP fails. Parsing purely numeric values with epoch_ms and leaving ISO strings on the existing cast fixes the failure without changing any output columns.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, t.parsed_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(t.parsed_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS parsed_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') t;"}}
